points: MOFCOM and MOST add 40 technologies to the export catalogue; 23 are AI items
AI items cover large models, agents, compute clusters and information processing
Exporters must register now; comments close 15 November 2026
take: Access to Chinese frontier models and agent tech could tighten. Open-source releases are excluded, so open weights stay outside the draft for now.
title: China: draft export curbs on 23 AI technologies, incl. models and agents
